added_lines: second collection today sunday 18th oct. – mission sunday (propagation of the faith) envelopes for your november offerings & lists are available in the church. masses on fridays in november will be offered for the faithful departed on the lists. the final dance at startrax, knocknagree on today sun 18th 2pm dancing with norella every wednesday at 8.15pm in the community centre. ceili in the old school house, foilogohig, ballydesmond on fri 23rd oct 9pm. music by neily o connor. all welcome duggan steel, millstreet are recruiting a full-time administrative assistant. see notice board for more details. torc community and family resource centre is delighted to welcome john lonergan to teach íosagáin, rathmore, on 4th november 8pm, for an engaging and thought- provoking talk on “parenting in a modern society.” john is a highly respected speaker who served as governor of mountjoy prison for over 22 years and governor of portlaoise prison for almost four years. following his retirement in 2010, he published his autobiography, the governor , and later wrote parenting – raising your child in ireland today . drawing on his extensive experience and insights, john will explore the challenges and realities of parenting in today’s society. everyone is welcome to attend! last sunday’s collection amounted to € 1,155. we thank you for your generosity. diocesan collection: today’s collection is for mission sunday. this collection is vital to finance missionary work worldwide. your prayers and practical support, particularly on world mission will be a great help in bringing the gospel of god’s love to everyone, especially the poorest and those most in need. recently deceased: please remember in your prayers marie leane, coolkeragh who died recently. marie will repose at her residence in coolkeragh (v31 kh33) on monday from 4.00 p.m. until 7.00 p.m. requiem mass will take place here on tuesday morning at 11.00 a.m. may she rest i n peace. parish deaths: mass on sunday, november 15th will be offered for all who died in the parish in the past twelve months. we will also remember and pray for all, who were born and grew up in our parish, who have died elsewhere. please let us know any names you would like to add to this list. blood donation clinic: at the listowel arms hotel on monday 19th & tuesday 20th october from 4:50pm – 8:10pm. phone 1800 222 111 for appointment. new donors welcome at all clinics. a pre-amber alert has been issued in line with the national blood shortage pla n. fuchsia café morning : tuesday 27th october and the last tuesday of each month thereafter at the listowel arms hotel. a welcoming space for those with dementia, their carers & famili es. enjoy a free cuppa, music, quizzes and craic and to meet new friends. for more info contact
